claim.location: Table 4, block ICLR 2026, row GPT, column Overall

data.source: 50 ICLR 2026 submissions (OpenReview, pre-revision versions) + 31 Nature Communications manuscripts; code and data released on GitHub

notes: Judge is the same model as the subject; Table 1 review length (3,447 words, n=50) is a judge-free alternative. Long inputs (15k words per paper) and 10k-token output budget.

resolution.plan: The 50 randomly sampled ICLR 2026 submissions (pre-revision text, Sec. 4.1.1) are identifiable only from the released dataset, and the C.4 system prompt is completed at run time with venue reviewer guidelines inserted from external documents and a programmatically appended output schema, with ICLR fields generated sequentially (Sec. 4.2, Appendix C.2). Take the manuscripts, guideline documents and schema from the release, run gpt-5-2025-08-07 at temperature 1.0 / medium reasoning, and judge with GPT-5 via the Appendix D rubric to get the mean overall score (6.7).
resolution.approximation: Judge is the subject model; 15k-word inputs make three seeds costly; the GitHub URL is not in the extracted text.
